title: Rainbow Deception
hook: What if you could see a rainbow as a full circle?
script: A rainbow unfurls as a full circle, its secrets hidden from view. The full circle unfurls when sunlight pierces water droplets at exactly 42 degrees. But that's not even the strange part – it forms even near the antisolar point. A rainbow isn't an object, but an angle, each person witnessing their own unique spectacle. We're witness to 80,000 fleeting civilizations as a single raindrop undergoes its eternal cycle. As sunlight refracts through water droplets at 42 degrees, the full circle's majestic beauty is revealed.
